item.description:
Reading Group

In the Spring of 2026, I organized a reading course on commutative algebra. We met Wednesdays 12:40 - 1:35 PM in MW 152.

Schedule

[Here] is a list of problems from Atiyah-Macdonald that we worked through. Another good resource is Altman-Kleiman’s A Term in Commutative Algebra which is essentially Atiyah-Macdonald++. Below is a list of dates we met as well as the problems for each day to discuss. The bolded problems were the ones that we presented each day.
